notes.title: Playtests completed... get ready for Wargames Fest!
notes.content:
[b]U-Boot: The Board Game - Digital Edition playtests have been completed![/b]

Thank you for participating and sharing your feedback! We truly appreciate your time and effort in helping us improve the game.

Based on your feedback, we’ve made several important updates:
[list]
[*] Bugfix for crew member healing mechanics
[*] New missions added 
[*] A lot of bugfixes related to the tutorial, closing dialogues, and using torpedoes.
[/list]
If you have any further thoughts or comments, feel free to send them our way via the feedback questionnaire, which can still be found in the main menu.

Additionally, we are excited to announce that we’ll be participating in the Wargames Fest on Steam! Stay tuned for more details!

Feel free to join our Discord server to stay connected and share your thoughts: https://discord.gg/bVpbxTZwKC

Thanks again, and we look forward to seeing you in the next phase of development!
